resultJson.title: Add FizzBuzz TDD sample
resultJson.body:
Adds a small `tdd_sample/` project showing red → green → refactor with FizzBuzz. It has `fizzbuzz()` and `fizzbuzz_range()`, `unittest` tests, and a README describing the workflow.

Run the tests from `tdd_sample/` with `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.

The diff also includes an Orca progress file, `.orca/runs/c8ac33fd9d64.progress.json`, which is tooling output and not part of the sample.
